name: @aws/threat-composer-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end / functional tests for the threat-composer web app. Kept outside packages/* so the app's Vitest config (which globs src/**/*.{spec,test}.{ts,tsx}) never tries to run these specs.

scripts.test:all: playwright test && playwright test --config=playwright.preview.config.ts && playwright test --config=playwright.variants.config.ts && playwright test --config=playwright.extension.config.ts
